message:
Let me try to build mruby directly with the C compiler. mruby can be built with rake normally, but since ruby isn't available, let me check if there's a way to build it manually. Actually, let me first just try to compile the fuzzer with the mruby source. Let me check the mruby build system:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && ls tasks/ && echo "---" && cat Makefile && echo "---" && ls build_config/' 2>&1 | head -50</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
